name: Residence Permit for the Purpose of Employment

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a preliminary employment agreement or formal employment contract to work for or under the direction of an employer, for remuneration. If employed by a third-country employer fulfilling a contract in Hungary, that arrangement must be separately documented. No general labour-market test or occupation-restriction communication is currently in force.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying employment agreement or contract.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial means (bank statements, income documentation)
Housing documentation (lease, ownership, or employer-provided letter)

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years initially, extendable by 1 additional year, maximum 3 years from first issuance

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- Residence Permit for the Purpose of Employment: employer sponsorship, 2+1 year duration cap, Georgia/Armenia/Philippines procedural annex, required documents

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. A Government Decree annex names Georgia, Armenia, and the Republic of the Philippines with distinct extension/reissuance procedural rules under a readmission-agreement framework -- this is a PROCEDURAL sub-rule for those three nationalities, not a restriction of the whole permit category to them; the permit is generally open to third-country nationals of any nationality with a qualifying job offer. family_can_join set FALSE at the route level based on a notable, counterintuitive confirmation in oif.gov.hu's own family-reunification factsheet (see hu_family_reunification): standard-employment permit holders are explicitly EXCLUDED from the list of sponsors who can bring family members to Hungary, unlike EU Blue Card or National Residence Card holders. work_rights set to 'restricted' since employment is tied to the specific sponsoring employer/contract. Extensions require the applicant to have resided in Hungary at least 90 days within any 180-day period, submitted 30-90 days before expiry.
